title: OpenDEA Assessment Question
description: A reusable, independently identifiable and versionable assessment asset (CR-AM-05A §16, §8). A Question never owns a maturity level (§17); it contributes evidence to Criteria through the canonical evidence chain (§13). Contextual binding to dimensions/capabilities/criteria/measures happens in the AssessmentItem inside an AssessmentInstrument (§24, §25) — not on the global Question definition — so the same Question can be used differently in different instruments.

sequence.description: Default ordering hint; an instrument may override via AssessmentItem.sequence (§25).

evidence.description: Evidence collection requirement (§22). References the canonical evidence model by type, without forcing a single evidence model onto the assessment metamodel.

supersedes.description: Question replacement lineage (§31): the question versions this version replaces. Creates lineage without destroying the old definition.
